lessons: Residual Add RMSNorm is not one unconditional callable boundary.
Do not substitute Torch RMSNorm for unavailable TE residual fork.
BDA training correctness needs exact dropout Philox/RNG-state replay; a separately sampled torch.rand mask is not an oracle.
R1 and R2 fused one-block H=1024 kernels passed correctness but failed the predeclared CV<=0.20 stability gate at 64x2x1024.
A raw speedup from a stability-blocked candidate is not optimization evidence and must not trigger R3/profile/promotion.
